author: Zintenka
body:
YML

It would be quite awesome if we had some YML stuffs that allowed us to change spawns and monuments from a simple point to cylinder, sphere and cuboid regions.

Also, to specify what materials are monument materials. If the material tag inside the monument syntax is not put then the plugin should assume that all blocks within that region are monument materials.

Also the option to repair monuments. Can work well with the regenerative blocks.

teams:
  red:
    (Point)
    spawn: 34.5,78,322.5,-180,0
    (Cuboid)
    spawn min: 34,78,322 
    spawn max: 34,78,322 
    yaw: -180
    pitch: 0
    (Cylinder)
    spawn: 34,78,322
    radius: 5
    height: 1
    yaw: -180
    pitch: 0
    (Sphere)
    spawn: 34,78,322
    radius: 5
    title: Jungle
    max: 25
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Right-A
        (Point)
        location: 67,12,183
        (Cuboid)
        min: 0,0,0
        max: 0,0,0
        (Cylinder)
        location: 67,12,183
        radius: 1
        height: 1
        (Sphere)
        location: 67,12,183
        radius: 1
        (Monument materials)
        block: obsidian
        block: lapis_block
        block: double_step
NOTE: If you want all the blocks to be monument materials within the region then you don't have to put this.
        (Repair)
        repairable: true
NOTE: After an objective is completed it cannot be repaired.

The regions for the spawn regions other than points - in spawns - aren't decimals because they base it upon the block - not the enitity's location.

blue-1:
    type: cuboid
    min: 3,68,-136
    max: -39,105,-114
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        allow: true
        triggers:
          regen:
            block: obsidian
            duration: 13s
If you want to make multiple blocks regenerative then you would have to make new triggers for each.
         modify_drops:
          type: coal_block
          drops:
            0:
              item: coal_block
              amount: 32
This syntax is broken and doesn't work most of the time whenever I make maps. Copied from one of my YMLs. Tell me what I'm doing wrong or if the syntax is just plain broken or doesn't work.
Kill-Death-Messages

Wouldn't it be awesome allowing TNT to actually display a person's kill instead of: "This-Person was blown up by TNT (White letters)" I feel that this is a very easy fix. However, it might not be... What are you Devs up to?

Just change that to this: "This-Person was blown up by Zintenka's TNT (Or creeper)"

Now if the TNT was launched by other TNT (Cannons) it would be based on the distance the TNT flew from it's first resting position. 
"This-Person was blown up Zintenka's Cannon. (65 blocks)"

Also, it would be funny to see how far a person fell when they died. 
  • (Suicide) "This-Person tripped over a step. (5 blocks)"
  • (Knocked) "This-Person was pushed over some stairs by Zintenka. (5 blocks)"
And if it exceeds 23 blocks then it changes to this:
  • (Suicide) "This-Person fell and broke their neck. (25 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from water) "This-Person fell from water and broke their neck. (25 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from ladder) "This-Person fell from a ladder and broke their neck. (25 blocks)"
  • (Knocked) "Zintenka broke This-Person's neck by pushing him (25 blocks)"
  • (Knocked from water) "Zintenka broke This-Person's neck by pushing (sniping) him (25 blocks) from water."
  • (Knocked from ladder) "Zintenka broke This-Person's neck by pushing (sniping) him (25 blocks) from a ladder."
If the fall is REALLY LARGE like say... exceeding 50 blocks:
  • (Suicide) "This-Person was turned into pizza. (56 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from water) "This-Person was turned into pizza while trying to go up water. (56 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from ladder) "This-Person was turned into pizza while trying to climb a ladder. (56 blocks)"
  • (Knocked) "This-Person was turned into pizza by Zintenka. (56 blocks)"
  • (Knocked from water) "This-Person was turned into pizza by (a sniper named) Zintenka whilst going up water. (56 blocks)"
  • (Knocked from ladder) "This-Person was turned into pizza by (a sniper named) Zintenka whilst climbing a ladder. (56 blocks)"
Now if the fall exceeds 100 blocks...
  • (Suicide) "This-Person fell from heaven. (115 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from water) "This-Person fell from a holy water drop. (115 blocks)"
  • (Suicide from ladder) "This-Person fell from a ladder of heaven. (115 blocks)"
  • (Knocked) "This-Person was thrown out of heaven by angel Zintenka. (115 blocks)"
  • (Knocked from water) "This-Person was flung (Sniped) off a holy water drop by angel Zintenka. (115 blocks)"
  • (Knocked from ladder) "This-Person was flung (Sniped) off a ladder of heaven by angel Zintenka. (115 blocks)"
